shadowSentences: The sky is very clear today.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your last travel experience?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important is travel planning to you?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite meal of the day and why?
Q2: Have you encountered any challenges with your eating habits?
Q3: How do you think our diet affects our health?
Q4: What tips would you give for maintaining a healthy diet?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy doing?
Q2: What obstacles do you face in keeping an exercise routine?
Q3: Why do you think regular exercise is important?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for someone starting to exercise?
